answer: A terrace system stops Sybil swarms: a new agent starts on the lowest terrace with tiny trade limits and must anchor its identity by locking a deposit and completing verified, useful work over time. Each higher terrace needs a larger locked stake plus a clean history, so one operator running a thousand fake identities must fund and maintain a thousand separate stakes and work records. A single relic of past good behaviour cannot be copied to a new identity, because reputation stays bound to the anchored, staked account that earned it.
